name: deliberate-dev
description: Clarify requests, plan small tasks, write tests first in isolated worktrees, and review before delivery.

interface.shortDescription: From a clear idea to tested, reviewed software.
interface.longDescription: Six skills guide AI agents through discovery, planning, tests before code, isolated Git worktrees, correctness/security/quality reviews, and verified integration. Local Python helpers create worktrees and check evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $deliberate-dev to clarify my idea and build it with tests and review.
Use $clarify-request to help me turn an idea into a clear requirement.
Use $review-delivery to review my completed work and test evidence.
